heading: `retain:` kwarg blocked
text:
### `retain:` kwarg blocked [LDTL.3.2]

With `dynamic_ttl: false`, the `retain: <expr>` kwarg on `emit`
targeting a `ttl`-lifecycle schema is a compile error when
the expression is not a compile-time constant ([LEXP.8.8]) equal to the schema's
declared TTL duration.

A `retain:` kwarg that is a compile-time constant matching the schema's
own TTL is redundant but not an error — it has no effect.  A `retain:`
kwarg with a different or non-constant value is a compile error
(`DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED`, [LDIA.3.4.2]).
